name: fantasy-net
title_zh: 给 C# 开发者装一个 Fantasy 服务器/Un
tagline_zh: 改 Fantasy 服务器代码或 Unity 客户端时，不用再翻 ECS、FTask、路由、K8s 文档——它直接。
tagline_en: Stop flipping through Fantasy docs when editing server or Unity code — it reviews and plans using Fantasy's own.
desc_en: This guide applies to development and code review for Fantasy / Fantasy.Net / Fantasy.Unity written in C#. Use it when a task involves Fantasy server code or Unity client code using Fantasy, ECS entities/components/systems, scenes and subscenes, FTask, network handlers/messages/protocols, Address or Roaming routing, Control Center and service discovery, Kubernetes deployment and Pod DNS binding, N
why_zh: 不是通用 C# 助手，而是把 Fantasy 的实体/组件/系统、子场景、网络消息。
why_en: Not a generic C# helper — it's loaded with Fantasy's ECS, subscenes, FTask, routing, service discovery, and Pod DNS rules, so.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Fantasy 系（Fantasy/Fantasy.Net/Fantasy.Unity）的 C# 开发与代码评。
limit_en: Only for Fantasy-family C# dev/review (Fantasy/Fantasy.Net/Fantasy.Unity). Outside this framework it misfires. No live K8s debugging — stops at.
